scheme_name: Scheme to Provide Grant in Aid to Cultural Organization (Maintenance/ Regular Grants)
other_conditions: Institution must be registered under the Society’s Registration Act, 1860 or the Indian Trust Act.
Preference is given to institutions involved in cultural education such as training in music, dance, drama, or fine arts.
benefits_summary: Grant-in-aid reimbursing up to 80% of the institution's expenditures, subject to a ceiling ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹3,00,000 depending on the group.
